== Suppressed Messages ==
# Add warning and/or information messages here after you've confirmed that they aren't really a problem
# (And include comments like this justifying why)
# See https://github.com/FHIR/sample-ig/blob/master/input/ignoreWarnings.txt for examples

# The narrative of the Group entries of the R4 READI sample Bundle is generated by the IG Publisher,
# whose Group renderer writes a fixed "metadata" anchor: with three Groups in one Bundle the anchor
# is repeated. It only affects in-page links to the Group metadata tables.
The html source has duplicate anchor Ids: metadata

# The deprecated maxValueSet extension is not used by this guide: it comes from the definitions of the
# R5 cross-version extensions (hl7.fhir.uv.xver-r5.r4) the profiles depend on.
The extension http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/elementdefinition-maxValueSet% is deprecated with the note: 'Use additionalBinding extension or element instead'

# No OIDs are assigned to the artifacts of this guide during its development (draft, FMM 0).
The resource % could usefully have an OID assigned (OIDs are easy to assign - see https://build.fhir.org/ig/FHIR/ig-guidance/oids.html)
